verdict.rationale: Cursor's docs directly claim this capability: a guide to 'Trace how a repo fits together and find the right places to start', which matches both halves of the story. The evidence is only a one-line doc heading, with no description of how the tracing or navigation actually works and no hands-on corroboration. missing for 10: detailed documentation of the codebase-exploration mechanism (e.g. indexing/semantic search, architecture tracing), independent or hands-on confirmation that it helps locate change entry points.

support.subject: As a developer, I can understand how a codebase fits together to find where to start making changes
